releaseTitle: DCEAY v1.2.1 — One App, All Your Music
changelog:
DCEAY Official Release: One App, All Your Music.
• Cover-to-Background Engine: transforms current song album artwork into dynamic blurred, animated gradient background.
• Syllable-Synced Lyrics Studio: word-by-word karaoke synchronization, translation toggle, and manual timestamp offset calibration.
• Universal Link Import: YouTube video/playlists, Spotify tracks/playlists metadata import, and direct audio stream vault.
• Personalization Studio: Cyberpunk Neon, Glassmorphism, and Midnight themes with accent color picker.
• GitHub In-App Auto-Updater: secure SHA-256 verification and Android PackageInstaller flow.
